description: Pinned toolchains for layout/generate_array.sh and the scaling builds in layout/extract_array_parasitics.sh (issue #91). Read by layout/generation_toolchain.py; see layout/README.md 'Reproducing the committed array (issue #91)'.

generation.purpose: klt gen mos_array + klt gen-compose: writes gain_cell_2t_array_mos.{gds,json} and gain_cell_2t_array.{gds,layout.json}
generation.verified: Issue #244: klt 0.8.0 generators (gen mos_array, gen guard_ring, gen-compose) emit a layout that is DRC clean, LVS match, ERC clean under the 0.8.0 deck, and reproduce the committed array byte-for-byte; see layout/README.md 'DRC under klt 0.8.0'. Supersedes the 2dd24b09 (0.4.0) generation pin recorded in layout/results/generation_reproduction_20261011.json. Issue #275 moved the check pin to 0.9.1 and left this one at 0.8.0, measured: klt 0.9.1 gen mos_array renames the emitted sub-PCell structure (mos_array -> <cell-name>__core) and adds a dogbone_terminals PCell parameter, so 0.9.1 generation no longer reproduces the committed GDS byte-for-byte even though nothing drawn changes: per-layer XOR empty on all 10 drawn layers (65/20, 65/44, 66/20, 66/44, 67/20, 67/44, 68/20, 93/44, 94/20, 95/20), identical bounding box and an identical set of 33 labels (on the separate label-only pairs 67/5 and 68/5), and DRC/LVS/ERC stay clean/match/clean. That geometry measurement is re-derived inside this repo by layout/xor_layout_geometry.py and recorded in layout/results/geometry_xor_klt0.9.1_vs_committed_20261114.json (issue #284) -- not asserted here unsourced; layout/test_generation_reproducibility.py binds this field to that record. See layout/README.md 'Generation and check pins diverge at klt 0.9.1 (issue #275)'.

check.purpose: klt drc / klt lvs / klt erc status gates. Same klayout-tools release as .github/workflows/signoff.yml KLT_VERSION (a PyPI pin, so no git commit), which produced the committed array DRC/LVS/ERC reports (klt_version 0.9.1). Tracks the signoff pin, which is why it can differ from the generation pin above (issue #275).
